item.title: Test ideas
item.content:encoded:
D-35425 was instructed to cut a piece of meat, as he went to cut it, 523 transformed into a balloon.

D-35426 was instructed to nail down a piece of wood with a hammer (SCP 523 was a thought to be the hammer, but had transformed into a nail) as D-35426 struck SCP 523, it transformed into azidoazide azide, a very sensitive, very dangerous contact explosive. D-35426 was killed and Dr. P. was injured.
After automatic alarms we're corrected, two hammers were found to be on site,

D-35427 was instructed to "figure out which hammer was real" after expressing confusion towards the order, he picked up both hammers and attempted to attack a guard, the hammer that was SCP 523 transformed into a bigger hammer, and caused D-35427 to fall. D-35427 was terminated by the guard.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Seemed highly informal, lacking the standard scientific tone. Crucial details are missing, such as:

What is its current form?
Are there limits to its size, abilities?
How was it discovered/contained?

Also, why would you keep such an incredibly dangerous object at your main facility? Why not somewhere less active?

You've got a formless object that generically does "something bad," and no one can see it happen, record it or understand it. Just seems lazy.
